Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, grant us such fear of You
That would prevent us from disobeying You

Arabic text: وَمِنْ طَاعَتِكَ مَا تُبَلِّغُنَا بِهِ رِضْوَانَكَ
Translation: And such obedience that would lead us to Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَمِنَ الْيَقِينِ مَا يَهُونُ عَلَيْنَا بِهِ مُصِيبَاتُ الدُّنْيَا
Translation: And such certainty that would make the calamities of this world seem insignificant to us
O Allah, let us benefit from our hearing, sight, and strength
As long as You keep us alive, and make them our inheritors
And take our revenge against those who have wronged us
And help us against those who show enmity towards us
And do not make our affliction in our religion

Arabic text: وَلَا تَجْعَلِ الدُّنْيَا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّنَا وَلَا مَبْلَغَ عِلْمِنَا
Translation: And do not make this world our greatest concern nor the extent of our knowledge
And do not let those who have no mercy for us overpower us
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones
